d_and_a.source: not found: D&A is null in the ESEF data (issuer tagged it with extension concepts); not filled from memory

capex.source: Same ESEF report, ifrs-full:PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentIntangibleAssetsOtherThanGoodwill... (PP&E and intangibles purchases)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: history shows FY2024 +8.6% and FY2025 +6.2% (ESEF revenue). Growth fades toward the terminal rate as the portfolio matures and patent expiries bite.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: reported EBIT margin was 18.4% FY2023, 17.7% FY2024, 14.5% FY2025 (ESEF). I used 17%, roughly the 3-year average of 16.9%, assuming a partial recovery from the FY2025 low.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: between the French statutory rate (~25.8%) and Damodaran's low Europe pharma effective rate (7.8%). Rounded estimate, not a filed figure.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: no filed D&A was available, so this has no filing support. I set it a little below capex at 8.1% of revenue, assuming D&A is lower than capex while the company keeps investing. The reviewer should replace it with the figure from the cash flow statement.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Filed capex/revenue: 7.7% FY2023, 7.8% FY2024, 8.1% FY2025 (ESEF). I used 8.0%.

wacc.source: CAPM. Rf 3.266% (ECB AAA 10Y, 2026-11-05). ERP 5.006% (Damodaran, France). Unlevered beta 1.086 (Damodaran Europe pharma, cash-corrected), relevered at D/E 0.159 and 22% tax to 1.215. Ke is about 9.35%. Pre-tax Kd is 5.74% (Damodaran), about 4.3% after tax. Weights are 86%/14% (Damodaran industry D/E, because there is no market cap). WACC is about 8.7%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: about long-run euro-area inflation and below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: ESEF report 549300E9PC51EN656011-2025-12-31-ESEF-FR-0: borrowings 14,248 non-current + 4,342 current = 18,590 total debt, less cash 7,657; no short-term investments reported. Excludes leases.
